ratings.justification: other: Brotli decoder buffer overflow (c/dec/decode.c, 1.0.3 to 1.2.0). v2.3.3 and earlier: the immich and immich-api node processes map libbrotlidec 1.2.0 (nixpkgs node uses the shared library), and immich 3.2.4's Express 5 / body-parser 2.3.0, registered globally by NestFactory, inflates request bodies sent with Content-Encoding: br before any guard runs: a POST of br-labelled garbage to /api/auth/validateToken returns 500 where the plain request returns 401 (probed on hrossen 2026-11-07, locally on port 2283). Risk there: critical: one unauthenticated HTTP request from the internet (network:proxy allows home, netbird, internet) reaches the decoder in immich-api, which runs as the immich user with the database and every photo; upgrade. Fixed after v2.3.3 (commit 54f16aab): immich.nix swaps the pinned brotli for the same package built from 1.2.1 (system.replaceDependencies); on hrossen 2026-11-07 immich, immich-api and the machine-learning worker map libbrotlidec.so.1.2.1. 1.2.0 stays in the closure only through the base system (template nixpkgs rev 1f607aa79b63: systemd's curl 8.22.0, freetype/fontconfig, nix), which decodes br only in HTTP responses to what the guest itself fetches; no immich process maps it.

analysis.detail: immich/nix:brotli. Risk there: critical: one unauthenticated HTTP request from the internet (network:proxy allows home, netbird, internet) reaches the decoder in immich-api, which runs as the immich user with the database and every photo; upgrade. Fixed after v2.3.3 (commit 54f16aab): immich.nix swaps the pinned brotli for the same package built from 1.2.1 (system.replaceDependencies); on hrossen 2026-11-07 immich, immich-api and the machine-learning worker map libbrotlidec.so.1.2.1. 1.2.0 stays in the closure only through the base system (template nixpkgs rev 1f607aa79b63: systemd's curl 8.22.0, freetype/fontconfig, nix), which decodes br only in HTTP responses to what the guest itself fetches; no immich process maps it. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

immich/nix:curl. libcurl 8.22.0 (nixos-unstable) is loaded into immich and immich-api only as a dependency of libvips' poppler and cfitsio loaders. poppler uses curl only to open a document by http(s) URL and libvips passes it bytes; cfitsio only when the file name is a URL, and immich passes its own upload paths. PDF and FITS are not accepted upload types; immich's own HTTP goes through Node. The system services (nix-daemon, NetworkManager) use the stable curl. Checked live on hrossen 2026-11-07. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

ratings.justification: other: Disputed upstream (ldd on a malicious ELF, treated by glibc as a non-security bug); the record names no affected versions. Kept counted as glibc is.

immich/nix:glibc. memalign alignment overflow in glibc 2.30 to 2.42 (the CVE's own text); NVD's range has no upper bound, and immich's glibc 2.44 carries the fix. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

ratings.justification: other: strfmon width padding overflow, real in glibc 2.44; only reachable if a program calls strfmon with right-justified padding — immich's Node and Python services do not. Kept counted as glibc is.

analysis.detail: immich/nix:glibc. strfmon width padding overflow, real in glibc 2.44; only reachable if a program calls strfmon with right-justified padding — immich's Node and Python services do not. Kept counted as glibc is. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

immich/nix:imagemagick. SUN coder error handling fixed in ImageMagick 6.8.9 (2014); 7.1.2-31 contains the fix, the match comes from a version-less CVE record. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
immich/nix:imagemagick. Double free in profile.c fixed in 6.9.7-4 / 7.0.4-4; 7.1.2-31 contains the fix. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

ratings.justification: not-used: Missing end-of-file check reading bzip2-compressed blob data (MagickCore/blob.c), an endless loop; fixed in 7.1.2-32. immich-api loads this ImageMagick through libvips (no VIPS_BLOCK_UNTRUSTED), which picks a loader by content, so a crafted upload from a signed-in user can reach it. Risk here: low: one media job spins, no memory corruption. Fix: an unstableSrc with imagemagick 7.1.2-32 or later (nixos-unstable has 7.1.2-34).

immich/nix:imagemagick. PSD decoder integer-conversion loop on 32-bit builds only; the immich VM runs the x86_64 build. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

immich/nix:imagemagick. NTGhostscriptEXE() launching gswin64c.exe by bare name is Windows-only code; the immich VM runs Linux, where ImageMagick calls the gs binary from its own store path. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

immich/nix:jellyfin-ffmpeg. The RTSP client; immich gives ffmpeg uploaded local files only, and ffmpeg's protocol whitelist for a file input does not open rtsp. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
immich/nix:jellyfin-ffmpeg. The WMA encoder (libavcodec/wmaenc.c); immich encodes audio only as AAC or Opus, never WMA. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

ratings.justification: other: Out-of-bounds read from unpadded IAMF extradata in the MOV demuxer (mov_read_iacb): immich probes (ffprobe) and transcodes every uploaded video, and immich is published to the internet — reachable by any user with a login, as the immich user. A read past a buffer, not a write. Not in FFmpeg 8.1.3 (fixed upstream in 8439e02, FFmpeg 9.0).
